about: Manual sign-off and accepted residual risks of one build. Checked by .github/check-signoff.py: the main CI checks the format, release-artefact.yml refuses a stable tag while an item is open. Status: open | done (the manual check was made, the result is in the issue) | accepted (the residual risk in docs/RESIDUAL-RISKS.md is accepted). done and accepted need date (YYYY-MM-DD) and by.

items.what: A person has read the NVDA transcripts of the release candidate (docs/MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE.md, section 1)
The upload to the Moodle plugins directory is made by hand, outside the gate; the SHA-256 is compared after the upload
Android Opera, Firefox Klar and a keyboard other than Gboard tried on a device (docs/MANUAL-ACCEPTANCE.md, section 2)
STACK is installed from its moving branches in CI, not pinned
One configuration per scope is enforced by lock and transaction, not by a unique index (docs/DATA-INTEGRITY.md)
Builds 2026100700 and 2026100800 both carry the release name 1.3.0
